title: Conversations and realtime

features.name: Conversation list
features.summary: Shows the user's conversations and opens one on tap. Refreshes when the server reports a thread update.
user_actions: tap a conversation to open it
flow: screen appears and loads threads via fetchThreads (Features/Threads/ThreadListView.swift:10, ThreadListViewModel.swift:8)
tap navigates to the thread route (Features/Threads/ThreadListViewModel.swift:14-16)
states_and_edge_cases: load failure: silently shows an empty list
known_issues: load failure is swallowed with try? and shows the empty state

features.name: Read and send messages in a conversation
features.summary: Opens a conversation, joins its realtime channel, shows incoming messages and typing, and sends new messages with one silent retry.
user_actions: long-press a message to report it
flow: open: fetchMessages, then join the realtime thread (Features/Thread/ThreadViewModel.swift:13-15)
incoming messageReceived appends to the list (Features/Thread/ThreadViewModel.swift:18-19)
send: sendMessage, append on success, show error on failure (Features/Thread/ThreadViewModel.swift:29-43)
states_and_edge_cases: send button disabled while sending or when draft is empty
known_issues: typing action is sent on every keystroke without throttling
leaveThread is never sent when the screen closes

features.name: Realtime socket connection
features.summary: Single shared socket that decodes incoming message types and sends outgoing actions.
known_issues: onMessage is a single closure: whoever sets it last wins

unassigned_files.reason: shared API client, used by every feature

open_questions: Is the silent retry in send intentional or a workaround for flaky networking?
